source.images: HF community mirror bevaya/RICO-ScreenQA, validation parquet shards
source.residual_risk: community mirror rather than official RICO release; automatic duplicate checks see annotated evidence only, so exhaustive post-generation visual audit is mandatory

visual_audit.join_policy: exact question-id set and exact payload match; missing, unknown, duplicate, malformed, or unverified records fail
visual_audit.policy: failed locations are removed post-generation and are never replaced without a new exhaustive audit

selection_rule: >=3 usable content questions and a distinct-qid half/grid candidate pair; 1080x1920 first; seeded base 25; greedy balance expansion capped at 35

location_generation_rules.position_rule: median over per-annotator bbox centers; source_bbox is the rounded element-wise median for display only
location_generation_rules.half_template: top/bottom; reject center-y in closed 40-60% band and annotator half disagreement
location_generation_rules.grid3x3_template: thirds; reject centers within closed +/-5% boundary bands and annotator cell disagreement
location_generation_rules.duplicate_scope: automatic exact/substring checks cover annotated evidence elements only; visual audit covers the screen
location_generation_rules.candidate_selection: locally greedy underrepresented-grid then half; seeded random tie break

pairs_manifest.direction: content_to_location only, fixed as the pilot causal order. Reverse direction directly leaks qA only for same/partial-evidence pairs; cross-evidence reverse pairs are omitted for directional consistency, not because all contain qA answers.
pairs_manifest.evidence_rule: same qid => same; otherwise canonical text plus IoU>=0.8 or smaller-box containment>=0.9 => same; annotator-only exact intersection => partial; otherwise different
pairs_manifest.type_policy: selection/status/tab cues are grounding+uncertain and cannot receive automatic T4; every pair remains uncertain until two-reviewer adjudication

statistical_plan.unit_of_analysis: screen-macro; locations and content-location pairs within a screen are not independent

metric_definition.raw_accuracy: mean of each screen's mean correctness; each screen has total weight 1 regardless of question count
metric_definition.balanced_accuracy: macro recall on a screen-weighted confusion matrix; each question weight is 1 divided by the number of evaluated questions on its screen
metric_definition.macro_f1: fixed-label macro-F1 on the same screen-weighted confusion matrix
metric_definition.per_template: also report half and grid3x3 separately; within each template each retained screen contributes at most one question
metric_definition.zero_support: fixed labels with zero gold or prediction support remain in the average with recall/F1=0 (zero_division=0)

bootstrap.labels: fixed post-audit label universe and gold labels in every replicate; no relabeling or class dropping
bootstrap.paired_delta: for method comparisons, reuse the identical sampled screen indices per replicate and report method-A minus method-B
